B3.title: Harugumo: nearest ally and detection of its targets at each shot

data.note: B3 per shot. A shot = one distinct firing moment and target among the smoker's shell, torpedo and airstrike events credited to its own smoke. Damage = every credited event (shells, fires, torpedoes) times its credited share. Per smoke = mean over smokes of each smoke's own-gun damage share. Positions from tracks at the firing moment (2 s samples, interpolated). Detection = the target's own track flag. Radar = the radar log lit spans.

C5_LP_4.title: Loop: Daring smokes after a friendly radar lit an enemy destroyer

data.note: C5 Loop. before_X_W = a radar lit span on an enemy destroyer, attributed to a radar of the smoking team, overlapped the W seconds before the smoke was activated. any = anywhere on the map; near = while that destroyer was within 3 km of the edge of the cap nearest to the smoke. base = share of the moments between the game's first and last smoke (cut at the smoker's death) at which the same test is true (exact, no random draws). earlier / later = the round 5 control windows (120 to 60 s before; 60 to 120 s after). after = same test for the W seconds after activation; afterstart = a lit span began in those W seconds.
